text: Figure 8.1: Example of a Sender-Receiver Interface "ECUMCurrentMode" with a single ModeDeclarationGroup The ModeDeclarationGroup is a set of ModeDeclarations. Within the definition of the group, one ModeDeclaration describes the initial mode that is assumed at startup. For example, for the case of the ECU power state, the ModeDeclarationGroup "ECUM- Mode" could define the group of modes named { ST ARTUP_SHUTDOWN, RUN, POST_RUN, SLEEP , WAKE_SLEEP }, with ST ARTUP_SHUTDOWN as the initial mode.
